say:3:1423448001:1.text: I want to get food the kids will like... I'll buy as much as this money can get!
say:3:1423448001:1.source_cn: 我想买点孩子们爱吃的食物……这些钱能买多少我就买多少！

say:4:1423448002:1.text: Hate to break it to you, but that's barely enough for two loaves of bread.
say:4:1423448002:1.source_cn: 啧啧，恕我直言，您这些钱可买不了多少，顶多只能买两块面包。

say:5:1423448003:1.text: Things aren't like they used to be. Prices in the royal city are through the roof!
say:5:1423448003:1.source_cn: 世道不比以前了，现在王城里什么东西的价格不是飞涨！

say:6:1423448004:1.text: Two loaves won't be enough... there are so many mouths to feed...
say:6:1423448004:1.source_cn: 可是两块根本不够……那么多孩子……

say:7:1423448005:1.text: I remember the bread from Brimstone Village—it's bigger, tastier, and a lot cheaper too...
say:7:1423448005:1.source_cn: 我记得深岩村出产的面包个头又大又美味，比这里要实惠得多……

say:8:1423448006:1.text: We can go ask around in Brimstone Village for you. Their bread should be more affordable!
say:8:1423448006:1.source_cn: 祭司小姐，我们可以帮你去深岩村问问！那里的面包应该会便...

say:9:1423448007:1.text: Thank you! I'll leave the pouch with you. Please bring back as much as you can.
say:9:1423448007:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！钱袋就交给你们了，多带些面包回来吧！
